definitions.explanation: Fine tea particles left over from processing higher-grade tea leaves. An affordable, everyday tea commonly served at sushi restaurants and casual eateries. Not to be confused with matcha, which is stone-ground from specially cultivated leaves.

examples.japanese: ⟦{寿司屋|すしや}→寿司屋：10166_sushiya⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{粉茶|こなちゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{飲|の}んだ→飲む：00322_nomu⟧。
examples.english: I drank powdered tea at a sushi restaurant.

examples.japanese: {粉茶|こなちゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{安|やす}くて→安い：00464_yasui⟧⟦{手軽|てがる}→手軽：07176_tegaru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{楽|たの}しめる→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: Powdered tea is inexpensive and easy to enjoy.

examples.japanese: ⟦{回転|かいてん}{寿司|ずし}→回転寿司：11900_kaitenzushi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{店|みせ}→店：00497_mise⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{各|かく}→各〜：00449_kaku⟧⟦テーブル→テーブル：04488_teeburu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{粉茶|こなちゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{缶|かん}→缶：01076_kan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{置|お}いてある→置く：01092_oku⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: At conveyor-belt sushi restaurants, canisters of powdered tea are often placed at each table.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{粉|こな}→粉：02766_kona⟧ (powder) and ⟦{茶|ちゃ}→茶：03433_cha⟧ (tea). This is the fine tea dust or small leaf fragments that result from processing sencha and other green teas. At sushi restaurants it is often called あがり, a traditional term for the tea served at the end of a meal.

Distinct from ⟦{抹茶|まっちゃ}→抹茶：10574_maccha⟧, which is ceremonial-grade tea stone-ground from shade-grown tencha leaves. {粉茶|こなちゃ} is a byproduct of regular tea processing and is much cheaper.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {粉茶|こなちゃ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to brew powdered tea
- {粉茶|こなちゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{缶|かん}→缶：01076_kan⟧: canister of powdered tea
- {粉茶|こなちゃ}⟦パック→パック：11002_pakku⟧: powdered tea bags

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{抹茶|まっちゃ}→抹茶：10574_maccha⟧: matcha — higher-grade, stone-ground ceremonial tea
- ⟦{煎茶|せんちゃ}→煎茶：13407_sencha⟧: sencha — standard brewed green tea
- あがり: tea served at a sushi restaurant (trade term)
